title: India roundup: India's semiconductor ambitions' execution hurdles
html:
India is accelerating semiconductor investment through research projects, equipment localization and subsidies, but customer skepticism, manufacturing challenges and a major customs dispute underscore risks to its expanding technology ambitions.

Credit: AFP
